title: Matumizi ya Mimi na Sisi (Theme 1: Darasani)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 1 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child finds the word the grammar point depends on (the person, the noun and its ngeli, one or many) before choosing the form.

floor.prerequisite: Names everyday things and people in Kiswahili.
floor.question: Hiki ni nini? (kiti)

representations: picture and word cards sorted by ngeli or person
colour matching of the parts that agree
a short passage on darasani using the words
steps: Ask: one or many? Which ngeli or person?
contexts: a game with real objects in class
talking with a parent at home

board.say: Kitendo kinaanza na nini kwa sisi?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child makes his own sentence with the form and reads it aloud.

misconceptions.ask: Mwanzo wa kitendo unakubaliana na nani?
misconceptions.repair: Kitendo hufuata nafsi: Wao wanacheza; Yeye anacheza. (tunaimba)

misconceptions.ask: Ni mtu mmoja au watu wengi?
misconceptions.repair: Mtu mmoja ni yeye; watu wengi ni wao. (Sisi)
Ukiulizwa kwa "wewe", unajibu kwa "mimi". (Mimi ni Baraka.)

misconceptions.ask: Alama ya mtendwa iko wapi ndani ya kitendo?
misconceptions.repair: Tunasema "Mama alinipa", si "alimpa mimi". (Mama alinipa chakula.)
